name: MrJoned (he/him)
bio:
MrJoned, also known as Jon, is the Head of Fun on Silver Springs Survival. He runs occasional community events and maintains the Silver Springs website.

Jon first found the server on Christmas Day in 2012, after receiving Minecraft and searching online for a server to join. The welcoming community convinced him to stick around, make friends, and eventually apply for Moderator.

These days, his favorite part of Silver Springs is the custom content. He enjoys seeing the team create systems that make the server feel like “a whole new Minecraft.” He has also worked on projects like the VoidTek Labs spawn and the PvP arenas on the Caldera spawn map.

One of Jon’s favorite memories is the first Purge, before he joined the staff team. He enjoyed the temporary anarchic feeling of the server, especially when Star drained the ocean and spawned a Wither for everyone to fight.

Outside of Minecraft, Jon enjoys Elden Ring and very specifically prefers pepperoni pizza. His advice for new players is simple: “Join, and never look back!”

He is the worst mod. (Follow him on Twitter!) Despite being the worst mod, MrJoned also has a Twitch and a Youtube you should also follow!
history: MrJoned first became Moderator March 2nd of 2015 (along with EvilDrac) and has been an admin since September 25th of the same year. On September 17, 2023, Jon became the new Head of Fun.
